---
title: Chapter two (model prose, the input)
note: Written for the continuity tests; the section to convert.
---

Abraham builds the altar and lays the wood in order. He binds his son and lays him on the altar, on top of the wood, and the burnt-offering waits for its victim.

An angel calls from heaven and stops his hand. Abraham looks up and sees a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. He offers the ram in place of his son.
